newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish debt yields edge up taking overseas lead.
newsitem.headline: Swedish debt yields edge up taking overseas lead.

text.p: Swedish debt yields rose slightly on Thursday in a small foreign driven recoil, while the crown was largely unchanged.
"We followed foreign debt markets. Sweden's May producer prices also probably had a negative effect," one analyst said.
May producer prices rose by 0.7 percent, which was much higher than market expectations of 0.3 percent. Higher meat prices contributed to the rise.
"Despite the fact that there were one-time effects influencing producer prices, they still were higher than expected," an analyst said.
